cases.name: recipient-pull-production-issuer-restart
cases.intent: restart the built broker before one-use ticket redemption and run the shipped recipient handoff process
cases.expected_postcondition: ticket remains authorized; recipient applies only the synthetic value and broker records completion

cases.name: recipient-pull-production-recipient-restart
cases.intent: restart the shipped recipient process from its persistent operation journal and retry completion against a restarted broker
cases.expected_postcondition: idempotent receipt retry keeps the operation completed and exposes no credential
cases.observed_postcondition: completed; receipt retry output contains no synthetic credential

residual_risks: real AegisKeys credential resolution, grant policy, and rotation not exercised
provider and recipient side effects are independently observed only in the full cross-broker qualification
recipient application identity beyond UID pinning not proven
